parsed.post: New personal best! 0.9792 achieved by keeping DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.035, and reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144. It seems smaller batches (more optimizer steps) combined with the lower learning rate is a powerful combo for depth 8. Next: testing if an even lower LR of 0.025 can push this further.
parsed.description: Reduce MATRIX_LR from 0.035 to 0.025 while keeping the small batch size (262144) to probe the limits of stability/convergence at depth 8.
